item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02880","case1_error":"Gives unsupported $475 after correct formulas, which yield $752.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final $322.50 after formulas that yield $675.","reason":"Both supply incorrect final numbers without showing an erroneous numerical evaluation of their correctly written formulas.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02881","case1_error":"Incorrectly equates earnings to bike cost plus repairs, ignores the remaining-fifth condition, and divides post-repair money by apple price.","case2_error":"Leading answer marker says 20, but the derivation and concluding answer correctly give 120.","reason":"Case 2 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02882","case1_error":"Evaluates 36 × 9 as 432 instead of 324 within the correctly written volume expression.","case2_error":"Invents base and side dimensions from height and width; the shoebox’s requested uncovered area is geometrically underspecified.","reason":"Case 1 has a numerical evaluation error. Case 2’s question lacks sufficient dimensions or a clear covered surface, making its interpretation materially ambiguous.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02883","case1_error":"Divides among four people, omitting Jose from the five recipients.","case2_error":"Triples the already combined bedroom time, counts four workers instead of three, and fails to account separately for two bathrooms.","reason":"Omitting the owner from recipients differs from adding an extra worker and misrepresenting cleaning-time relationships.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02884","case1_error":"Treats four total overtime hours as daily overtime, multiplying their pay by five.","case2_error":"Adds Saturday earnings to weekday daily earnings, then multiplies both by five, counting Saturday pay five times.","reason":"Both incorrectly multiply a separate, once-per-period earnings component by the number of weekdays.","judgment":"same"}]}
